meta.purpose: Registry of public-records responses received and the chain from each request to the published finding. One entry per request. Structured so a future Public Records Archive page can be built from it without changing the data model.
meta.note: This registry is local, structured data. The public evidence archive it links to is an external convenience for independent inspection; ClayMoneyTrail never reads from it at runtime and works without it.

statusVocabulary.response_received_completeness_not_verif: A response was received but the original request wording has not been compared against what was produced.
statusVocabulary.fulfilled: The original request was compared with the production and everything requested was supplied.
statusVocabulary.partially_fulfilled: The original request was compared with the production and some requested items were not supplied.
statusVocabulary.open: No response, or the response is still being awaited.

responses.agency: Clay County Board of County Commissioners — Personnel and Benefits Department
responses.subject: Payroll reports, employee census, and benefits information for Board of County Commissioners employees

requestWording.note: The response package contains the county's cover letter but not the wording of the original request. Requested-versus-produced cannot be compared until the original request is located.

responses.statusNote: Do not treat this request as fulfilled or partially fulfilled until the original request wording is compared with the ten files produced. The county's letter states it can provide information for the BCC and not for the constitutional offices.
responses.description: Two Workday payroll report exports (FY2024-25 and FY2025-26 year to date), an employee census, three state FRS contribution-rate charts, and three benefits guides, delivered with a one-page cover letter.
responses.employerScope: Board of County Commissioners employees only. Constitutional offices and other employers are not covered.
filesReceived: 1. 2024 - New Hire Clay County BOCC Benefits Guide.pdf

publicArchive.label: Open Public Records Evidence Archive
publicArchive.maintainedBy: ClayMoneyTrail project researcher — not Clay County
publicArchive.explanation: A public Google Drive folder, maintained by the ClayMoneyTrail researcher (not operated or controlled by Clay County), that preserves source records received through public-records requests so anyone can inspect them. The original files are stored unaltered.
publicArchive.packageForThisFinding: The ZIP named above and the ten individual files it contains. The folder may hold other records; only this package was used for the PRR-2026-1195 payroll analysis, and not every file supports every finding.
publicArchive.verificationNote: Opened without signing in (HTTP 200). The archived ZIP's SHA-256 matches the hash above, and the archived payroll reports, census, and cover letter match the hashes of the same files inside the ZIP.
